summary: Computer Technology graduate with 1,800 hours of IT internship experience in shipping and logistics. Experienced in desktop troubleshooting, PC assembly using recovered functional components, Windows/software installation, computer maintenance, and end-user support. Contributed to development and testing of a company-directed biometric timekeeping system (BITS), including implementation of Manager and Employee dashboards. Seeking an entry-level IT Support or IT Staff role.

coreSkills.items: Desktop hardware diagnostics; PC assembly and component replacement; hardware/software maintenance; installation and configuration; end-user technical support
Manual and functional testing; bug fixing; test case execution; defect documentation and tracking
Basic Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL; Git and GitHub; AI-assisted software development
Microsoft Office; Google Workspace; data and record management; typing speed 90+ WPM

bullets: Provided day-to-day technical assistance to employees with desktop and laptop software issues.
Diagnosed desktop display, startup, and power issues; assembled usable PCs from working parts recovered from nonfunctional system units.
Performed hardware and software cleaning and maintenance, installed or configured Windows and software, and assisted with CCTV installation.
Collaborated on BITS, a company-directed ZKTeco K14 biometric timekeeping system; implemented the Manager and Employee dashboards.
Fixed bugs assigned through GitHub Kanban boards; manually tested attendance, shift, overtime, and reporting workflows and documented defects.
Reviewed inventory, administrative, and biometric attendance records for errors and inconsistencies.

projects.name: ArcaneTyper — Multiplayer Typing Game
bullets: Defined project requirements and guided AI-assisted development of a web-based typing game featuring survival, practice, and real-time duel modes, along with leaderboards, achievements, and user accounts.
Manually tested gameplay modes, scoring, and real-time multiplayer interactions; documented bugs and tracked enhancements through GitHub Issues.

projects.name: Mimic — Android Party Game with Private Encrypted Vault
projects.label: GitHub
bullets: Defined requirements and guided AI-assisted development of an Android social-deduction game featuring three game modes, five word packs, LAN multiplayer for up to eight players, and a private encrypted vault for photos, videos, and notes.

Manually tested gameplay and vault-security features, including gesture unlock, PIN setup, failed-PIN lockout, auto-lock, and encrypted video playback. Performed additional testing on a physical device running the release build.
Identified release-specific defects, including a vault setup issue on clean installs, and incorporated clean-install testing on a wiped physical device into the release-testing process.
